description: This PHP source file defines the CampaignsViewClassic class, which extends SugarView to handle view rendering for campaign modules in SuiteCRM. It manages file inclusion based on actions and provides module title parameter generation.

classes.name: CampaignsViewClassic
classes.description: A view class for the Campaigns module in SuiteCRM, responsible for rendering campaign views and managing file inclusion based on user actions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the view, setting the type based on the current action.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Handles the display logic by including the appropriate campaign view file based on the current action.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates title parameters for the module, including dynamic links and labels based on the current action and context.
